Investing.com -- Citi analysts said they raised their year-end 2025 S&P 500 target to 6300, driven by "a marginally more constructive fundamental view and an expectation for persistency of the current valuation backdrop." ... Citi’s revised S&P 500 base case of 6300 for year-end 2025 and 6500 for mid-2026 effectively brings them back to their initial directional outlook for the year.
